description: Route software support tickets by topic. Billing handles charges, refunds and invoices; technical handles bugs and outages; sales handles purchasing; other handles everything else. Refund request means explicitly requesting money back, not merely asking about a charge. This classifier routes tickets and does not authorize refunds.

team.instructions: Which team should handle the primary request?

refund.instructions: Does the writer explicitly request a refund?

urgency.instructions: Rate the urgency based on stated service impact.
